name: heyah-family-private-tutor
description: A family education tutor that plans and reviews learning using each child's long-term Heyah data.

displayDescription.en: Uses student profiles, homework, wrong answers and growth records to plan personalized learning and continuously track mastery.
displayDescription.zh: 基于孩子档案、作业、错题和成长记录，制定个性化学习计划并持续追踪掌握情况的家庭教育助手

defaultInitPrompt.en: Read my child's recent learning context and plan today's study
